findings.message: All string literals use double quotes, but biome.json mandates javascript.formatter.quoteStyle='single'. This is the third wave in sprint-002 where this anti-pattern recurs (first_seen=wave-2 per do-not-recur.md). Auto-fixable via `biome format --write`.
findings.suggested_fix: Run the project's formatter (biome) to convert double-quote string literals to single quotes across the six new files in apps/api/src/shared/. Builder protocol for TS files should include a formatter pass.

findings.message: Double-quote string literals violate biome quoteStyle='single' (recurrence of wave-2 pattern). Note: 'req.headers.authorization' and the redact path strings remain semantically correct under either quote style.
findings.suggested_fix: Run `biome format --write apps/api/src/shared/logger.ts`. Confirm verification gates (which use single-quoted rg patterns to match double-quoted string contents) still pass — they will, because rg matches the literal characters inside the strings.

Uses `as any` with an `eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` pragma, but the project lints with biome (suspicious.noExplicitAny: 'error') which does NOT honor ESLint pragmas. The cast will be flagged once biome lint is wired in (planned per do-not-recur wave-3 finding #4). Additionally, `schema: {}` defeats Drizzle's relational query API (db.query.*) — the file comments acknowledge this needs a follow-up.
findings.suggested_fix: Either (a) replace `{} as any` with `{} as Record<string, never>` (still produces a degraded Db type but eliminates the `any`), or (b) defer drizzle initialisation until the schema barrel exists in a later wave and export a lazy getter. Option (b) matches the file's own TODO and avoids leaking a typed-loosely Db across the codebase.

findings.message: AppError.code is typed as `string` even though every subclass narrows it to `ErrorCode` (the imported branded enum from @medbridge/contracts). Callers reading `err.code` get `string` instead of the exhaustive union, defeating the purpose of importing the type.
findings.suggested_fix: Change `readonly code: string` to `readonly code: ErrorCode` and update the constructor parameter type to `code: ErrorCode`. Subclasses already pass a value of that type.

findings.message: Parameter name `hash` shadows the exported function `hash` (line 3). Inside `verify`, the identifier `hash` resolves to the argument, which is confusing and prevents calling the outer `hash` from within the function body.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename the parameter to `hashed` (or `passwordHash`) in both `verify` and `createPasswordVerifier`. Update the matching type in `PasswordVerifier`.

findings.message: process.env['DATABASE_URL'] is passed directly to Pool without a runtime check. When unset, pg silently falls back to individual PG* env vars or libpq defaults — a misconfiguration is easy to miss until first query.
findings.suggested_fix: Either throw at module load if `process.env.DATABASE_URL` is missing, or move env validation into a centralized `config.ts` (likely a later wave). The latter is preferable to keep db.ts minimal.

findings.message: Bitwise operator precedence is correct (`<<` binds tighter than `|` in JS), but the inline expression mixing `&`, `<<`, and `|` without parentheses around the `(x << 8)` clause is hard to scan during review.
findings.suggested_fix: Add explicit parens: `const randA = ((BigInt(rand[0] ?? 0) & 0x0fn) << 8n) | BigInt(rand[1] ?? 0);`. Pure readability — no behavioral change.
